name: samtagon-studio-website
description: Minimal showcase website for Samtagon Game Studio

scripts.build: bun build src/ts/main.ts --outfile dist/js/bundle.js --minify && bun build src/ts/recommendations-page.ts --outfile dist/js/recommendations.bundle.js --minify && bun run bundle:api && tsc
scripts.bundle:api: bun build api-src/search.ts --outfile api/search.js --format=cjs --minify --sourcemap=none && bun build api-src/status.ts --outfile api/status.js --format=cjs --minify --sourcemap=none

author: Samtagon Studios
